chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Muthanna ibn al-Walid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever spends the night with seven leaves of endive inside his stomach will be safe from colitis that night, if God wills.

key_terms.الْقُولَنْجِ: Colitis, an inflammation of the colon
key_terms.الْهِنْدَبَاءِ: Endive, a type of leafy vegetable known for its medicinal properties
key_terms.طَاقَاتٍ: Leaves or portions (specifically seven in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating endive before sleeping according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the prophetic tradition of using endive (Hindaba) as a preventative remedy for colitis (Qolonj), reflecting the broader Shia emphasis on practical medicine (Tibb) derived from the Imams. The specific mention of 'seven leaves' underscores the precision often found in traditional remedies, linking physical health to spiritual well-being through daily habits. It serves as a reminder of the holistic approach to health in Shia jurisprudence, where natural substances are utilized with divine permission.
